items: Durable maintenance transaction/journal with backup, fsync, deterministic interrupted-copy detection and rollback. HANDOFF_PENDING alone is not an installer.
Cold drain and identity-verified stop of old unfenced loaded controllers/workers; no hot replacement and no old-instance/bootstrap gap.
Maintenance ownership of the same existing flock inode throughout commit/rollback; preserve worker inherited leases, canonical counters/history/receipts and ROOT dirty/auth/private data.
Explicit approved ROOT/WORK bundle and ROOT Game source synchronization plus cold-reload compatibility checks. Runtime signature covers ten listed files, not complete Game or production content.
Safe bootstrap/resume/recovery after interrupted maintenance, with canonical authority and strict original production/readiness gates. stopP06 and separate P07 production controls remain unchanged.
